citation: 12 CFR Part 223 — Transactions Between Member Banks and Their Affiliates (Regulation W)
edition: Annual edition of the Code of Federal Regulations, Title 12, Parts 220 to 229, revised as of January 1, 2025 (the latest annual edition available on the retrieval date: the 2026 volume was not yet published at the same address)

volume_file.note: The whole volume covers Parts 220 to 229 and is not deposited; only the Part 223 slice below is.

slice.how: lines 4838 to 6474 of the volume file, from the opening PART element of Part 223 to the line before the next opening PART element, taken with sed -n; no byte was altered

rendering.how: python3 -I assemble-source.py, from the slice only; nothing reaches the network

not_obtained: The first route tried, the part-level file under /content/pkg/, answered HTTP 502 for every request (including for a Part 227 file that was fetched from the same place on an earlier date); the volume under /bulkdata/ answered normally. One download of the volume was made. The eCFR was not requested.
